# Measuring a force

<!-- STEP id="weight" -->
A spring balance measures weight: the force with which the Earth pulls an object. It can measure other pulls too. Pull its hook with your hand, and it reads the force of your pull.

<!-- STEP id="small" -->
The lightest touch we can feel is a force of about one millinewton, a thousandth of a newton.

In special experiments, scientists can measure forces far smaller, down to a yoctonewton: 10 to the power -24 N.
